item.title: Israeli president invites Netanyahu's opposition leader to broker new government
item.description: Israel's political landscape shifts as President Herzog hands opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot the mandate to form a government, dealing a blow to Benjamin Netanyahu's grip on power.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Frayer

item.title: A correspondent finds Cuba's people struggling
item.description: Reporting from Cuba comes with distinct challenges especially amid widespread power outages and fuel shortages.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel J. Sánchez

item.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
item.description: Gadi Eisenkot ran as the main rival to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but neither won enough support to command a majority. Israel's main parties have recommended Eisenkot form a new government.
item.dc:creator: Tara Neill

item.title: Ousted Paraguayan president appears before prosecutors
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was removed from office and placed under house arrest Friday. The Senate voted on his impeachment after the collapse of a state-affiliated bank.
item.dc:creator: Ava Berger

item.title: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
item.description: Israel's center-right opposition has a chance to unseat Netanyahu — but backing of Arab-led parties will be key.
item.dc:creator: Ruth Sherlock

item.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.
item.dc:creator: Carrie Kahn

item.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
item.description: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.
item.dc:creator: Jenna McLaughlin

item.title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats
item.description: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week. Three broadcasters also received threats.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
